# Fuse at profile vertex

Reduced from CAD-Recode validation stem `236`. At heights 0 through 3 the
slanted parallelogram adds its portion above y=3. The clipped polygon has
vertices (-3.5, 3), (-1, 3), (-2, 5) and (-4, 4). Its area by the shoelace
formula is 15/4. Above height 3 only the 12 × 4 rectangle contributes.

`oracle.json` records this program on CadQuery 2.3.0 and Open CASCADE
7.9.3.0.

Adapted from CAD-Recode validation by Danila Rukhovich, Elona Dupont,
Dimitrios Mallis, Kseniya Cherenkova, Anis Kacem and Djamila Aouada.
